description: Scrape one public URL through the egress gate: markdown (default), links, html, json (schema/instruction, your AI profile), or metadata (embedded JSON-LD, Microdata, RDFa, OpenGraph, meta tags; a JSON, XML or CSV body read into its structure; no model). Pending after wait_seconds: call apex_scrapy_scrape_result with the job_id. engine=browser renders the page in a sandboxed browser first (on a dedicated deployment, when enabled), with an optional passive wait_for_ms; the result's engine says which engine ran. only_main_content (default true), include_tags and exclude_tags shape the markdown format. Selectors are a safe CSS subset: type, .class, #id, [attr], [attr=value] and *, joined by descendant (space) or child (>) combinators; at most 20 of 200 characters. Use when: you need one page's content now. Not for: several URLs (use apex_scrapy_batch_scrape), a whole site (use apex_scrapy_crawl_site) or only its URL list (use apex_scrapy_map_url). Each call is charged as one scrape. Next: while pending, the result's next_call, after poll_after_seconds.
name: apex_scrapy_scrape_url
